overview: Docket: Grummon reports Dairen's military police monitored RCA's shortwave-radio sales to local dealers.

people.name: Philip D. Grummon
people.role: Official reporting from Dairen; precise position is not stated on the sheet

subfiles.title: List of Papers: Surveillance of Shortwave Radio Sales in Dairen
subfiles.from: Department of State, indexing a report from Grummon at Dairen
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes a report that military police required the Dairen manager of the RCA Victor Company to identify sales of shortwave radio sets to local dealers.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Grummon's 1936 report that Dairen's military police monitored RCA's shortwave-radio sales to dealers.

interest: Index on 1936 Dairen military surveillance of radio sales.
